requirements.title: The aggregate MUST emit a schema-versioned, immutable, content-addressed build-output receipt whose filename digest matches canonical receipt bytes. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-001)
requirements.text: The aggregate MUST emit a schema-versioned, immutable, content-addressed build-output receipt whose filename digest matches canonical receipt bytes. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-001)

requirements.title: The receipt MUST bind the exact source revision/tree and clean-worktree state, all declared source/configuration/dependency-lock inputs, owning command identity, and relevant tool names/versions. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-001)
requirements.text: The receipt MUST bind the exact source revision/tree and clean-worktree state, all declared source/configuration/dependency-lock inputs, owning command identity, and relevant tool names/versions. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-001)

requirements.title: The receipt MUST bind the main Fable output, Rules Explorer output, production client bundle, documentation site, and their expected paths/content identities without timestamps or machine-local paths. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-001)
requirements.text: The receipt MUST bind the main Fable output, Rules Explorer output, production client bundle, documentation site, and their expected paths/content identities without timestamps or machine-local paths. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-001)

requirements.title: Documentation qualification MUST accept only a verified receipt and reuse its existing client/Fable outputs instead of invoking the nested Fable/client build again. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-002)
requirements.text: Documentation qualification MUST accept only a verified receipt and reuse its existing client/Fable outputs instead of invoking the nested Fable/client build again. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-002)

requirements.title: Delivery and browser qualification MUST consume the same verified production outputs and retain every existing normal behavior assertion and protected mutation. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-002)
requirements.text: Delivery and browser qualification MUST consume the same verified production outputs and retain every existing normal behavior assertion and protected mutation. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-002)

requirements.title: Receipt verification MUST reject revision/tree, dirty-state, source/configuration input, package-lock, tool-version, owning-command, expected-path, missing-output, and output-content drift with actionable subject names. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-003)
requirements.text: Receipt verification MUST reject revision/tree, dirty-state, source/configuration input, package-lock, tool-version, owning-command, expected-path, missing-output, and output-content drift with actionable subject names. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-003)

requirements.title: A protected self-restoring mutation MUST alter one bound reuse subject, prove verification fails red with its expected diagnostic, and restore the subject byte-for-byte even on failure. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-003)
requirements.text: A protected self-restoring mutation MUST alter one bound reuse subject, prove verification fails red with its expected diagnostic, and restore the subject byte-for-byte even on failure. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-003)

requirements.title: Feedback validation MUST accept focused immutable command receipts bound to their exact audit head and declared evidence subject so feedback-only report/audit commits do not require a second full aggregate. (Stories: US-003; Acceptance: AC-004)
requirements.text: Feedback validation MUST accept focused immutable command receipts bound to their exact audit head and declared evidence subject so feedback-only report/audit commits do not require a second full aggregate. (Stories: US-003; Acceptance: AC-004)

requirements.title: Committed or reproducible timing evidence MUST record comparable before/after wall time, host facts, command identities, and subject inventory and MUST demonstrate a material single-pass reduction. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-005)
requirements.text: Committed or reproducible timing evidence MUST record comparable before/after wall time, host facts, command identities, and subject inventory and MUST demonstrate a material single-pass reduction. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-005)

requirements.title: The implementation MUST preserve the lean workflow of focused edit-time tests, one post-freeze aggregate, metadata-only feedback finalization, and one hosted final CI execution. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-006)
requirements.text: The implementation MUST preserve the lean workflow of focused edit-time tests, one post-freeze aggregate, metadata-only feedback finalization, and one hosted final CI execution. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-006)

decisions.title: The aggregate producer is the sole writer of a canonical content-addressed receipt; all reuse is verify-only and never silently rebuilds or refreshes stale output.
decisions.decision: The aggregate producer is the sole writer of a canonical content-addressed receipt; all reuse is verify-only and never silently rebuilds or refreshes stale output.

decisions.title: Receipt currency is a closed, sorted inventory of revision/tree/clean state, declared input-file digests, exact tool versions, owning command/schema, expected relative output roots, and recursive output digests.
decisions.decision: Receipt currency is a closed, sorted inventory of revision/tree/clean state, declared input-file digests, exact tool versions, owning command/schema, expected relative output roots, and recursive output digests.

decisions.title: Feedback command evidence uses immutable focused receipts whose declared subject excludes feedback-only metadata from product inputs; validator exact-head checks remain fail-closed and never infer a pass from prose.
decisions.decision: Feedback command evidence uses immutable focused receipts whose declared subject excludes feedback-only metadata from product inputs; validator exact-head checks remain fail-closed and never infer a pass from prose.

decisions.title: Timing evidence compares baseline and candidate on the same host and equivalent subject inventory, records raw wall time, and treats at least 20 percent reduction plus eliminated duplicate target counts as material.
decisions.decision: Timing evidence compares baseline and candidate on the same host and equivalent subject inventory, records raw wall time, and treats at least 20 percent reduction plus eliminated duplicate target counts as material.

decisions.title: The stale-reuse mutation exercises the production verifier against a temporary changed bound subject, requires the specific red diagnostic, and proves the original tracked/build subject digest is unchanged afterward.
decisions.decision: The stale-reuse mutation exercises the production verifier against a temporary changed bound subject, requires the specific red diagnostic, and proves the original tracked/build subject digest is unchanged afterward.
